# The paths that may be deleted from the source tree.
#
# One path per line, exactly as git reports it, nothing else.  A pull
# request that deletes a path that is not listed here fails the
# "protect-source" workflow.
#
# The agent never adds a path to this file, only the owner does.  The file
# exists for the rare case that a file really has to leave the source tree,
# for example a binary that is published as a release asset instead.
#
# Example:
# opencode_2.0.22_aarch64.deb
